mechanisms.label_th: Nasal Breathing — Nitric Oxide Production และ Bohr Effect
mechanisms.label_en: Nasal Breathing: Sinus Nitric Oxide Production and Bohr Effect Optimization
mechanisms.description_th: Nasal sinuses ผลิต Nitric Oxide (NO) จาก L-arginine ผ่าน NOS enzyme เมื่อหายใจผ่านจมูก; NO ถูกพา downstream ไปยัง bronchi และ alveoli → smooth muscle relaxation → bronchodilation + vasodilation → เพิ่ม V/Q matching; ปาก breathing ไม่ผ่าน sinus → NO production ถูก bypass; CO₂ ใน blood → Bohr effect → hemoglobin ปล่อย O₂ (chronic hyperventilation ล้าง CO₂ ออก → O₂ ถูก hold ใน hemoglobin → functional hypoxia แม้ SpO₂ สูง)
mechanisms.description_en: Nasal sinuses produce NO from L-arginine via NOS when breathing nasally; NO travels downstream → bronchial smooth muscle relaxation → bronchodilation + vasodilation → improved V/Q matching; mouth breathing bypasses sinus → no NO; CO₂ drives Bohr effect (hemoglobin releases O₂ in high CO₂ tissues); hyperventilation washes out CO₂ → O₂ held in hemoglobin → functional hypoxia despite high SpO₂.

chain.action: NOS (nitric oxide synthase) converts L-arginine to
chain.effect: NO produced with each nasal breath
cGMP increase → smooth muscle relaxation → bronchodilation
improved gas exchange efficiency + antimicrobial effect on inhaled pathogens

chain.actor: Adequate CO₂ in blood (from moderate, not excessive breathing)
chain.action: shifts hemoglobin oxygen dissociation curve right
chain.effect: Bohr effect: O₂ released to tissues more readily
O₂ trapped in hemoglobin → tissues hypoxic despite SpO₂ 98-99%

analogies_th: nasal breathing = ตัวกรองอากาศ + factory NO; ปาก breathing = ข้าม factory ทั้งหมด
CO₂ = คันเร่งให้ hemoglobin ปล่อย oxygen; hyperventilate = เหยียบเบรก oxygen delivery

sources.title: Nasal nitric oxide in man — Gustafsson LE et al.

mechanisms.label_th: Asthma Pathophysiology — Th2 Inflammation + Airway Remodeling
mechanisms.label_en: Asthma: Th2-Driven Airway Inflammation and Chronic Remodeling
mechanisms.description_th: Allergen trigger → APC ใน airway → Th2 cell activation → IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 release; IL-4/13 → IgE class switching ใน B cells → IgE binds mast cells; Re-exposure → mast cell degranulation → histamine + leukotrienes (LTD4) → acute bronchoconstriction; IL-5 → eosinophil recruitment → airway inflammation + mucus hypersecretion; Chronic: smooth muscle hypertrophy + basement membrane thickening → irreversible airway remodeling
mechanisms.description_en: Allergen → Th2 activation → IL-4, IL-5, IL-13; IL-4/13 → IgE production → IgE binds mast cells; re-exposure → mast cell degranulation → histamine + LTD4 → acute bronchoconstriction; IL-5 → eosinophil recruitment → inflammation + mucus; chronic: smooth muscle hypertrophy + basement membrane thickening → airway remodeling.

chain.actor: Allergen (dust mite, pollen, mold) in airway
chain.target: naive T-cells → differentiate to Th2 polarization
chain.effect: Th2 dominance: IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 cytokine production

chain.action: signal B cells to undergo IgE class switching
chain.target: IgE production → bound to high-affinity FcεRI on mast cells
chain.effect: sensitized mast cells ready to degranulate on re-exposure

chain.actor: Allergen re-exposure → IgE cross-linking on mast cells
chain.effect: acute bronchoconstriction, mucus secretion, vascular leak (early phase)
eosinophil major basic protein damages epithelium → late phase (4-12h) persistent inflammation

chain.target: airway smooth muscle hypertrophy + collagen deposition in subepithelial fibrosis
chain.effect: airway remodeling → fixed obstruction even when not in attack

analogies_th: asthma = alarm ที่ trigger เกินความจำเป็น ทำให้ปอดอักเสบซ้ำๆ จนผนังหนาขึ้น
mast cell = บอมบ์ที่ถูก wire ไว้กับ IgE — allergen = trigger

sources.title: Inspiratory muscle training in COPD — Beaumont M et al.

mechanisms.label_en: COPD: Neutrophil-Driven Protease Imbalance and Alveolar Destruction
mechanisms.description_th: Cigarette smoke/pollution → oxidative stress + PAMP signals → neutrophil + macrophage recruitment ใน airway; neutrophil elastase + MMP-9 ทำลาย alveolar wall (elastin, collagen) → emphysema (permanent air space enlargement → air trapping → hyperinflation); smoke → mucus hypersecretion + goblet cell hypertrophy → chronic bronchitis; small airway fibrosis → irreversible obstruction (FEV1/FVC < 0.7 = diagnostic criterion)
mechanisms.description_en: Cigarette/pollution oxidative stress → neutrophil + macrophage recruitment → neutrophil elastase + MMP-9 destroys alveolar wall → emphysema (permanent alveolar enlargement, air trapping, hyperinflation); smoke → mucus hypersecretion + goblet cell hypertrophy → chronic bronchitis; small airway fibrosis → irreversible obstruction (FEV1/FVC < 0.7).

chain.action: enter bronchi and alveoli → generate ROS + PAMP-like signals
chain.target: NF-κB activation in airway epithelium and macrophages
chain.effect: IL-8, TNF-α secreted → neutrophil chemotaxis
alveolar wall destruction → permanent air space enlargement (emphysema)
dynamic airway collapse on expiration → air trapping → hyperinflation → barrel chest

chain.actor: Chronic smoke exposure → goblet cell hyperplasia
chain.effect: mucus plugging + fibrosis → chronic bronchitis (cough + phlegm ≥3 months/year for 2 consecutive years)
FEV1/FVC < 0.70 post-bronchodilator = COPD diagnosis (GOLD)

analogies_th: emphysema = ปอดเป็นฟองน้ำเก่าที่หมดความยืดหยุ่น — หายใจออกไม่หมด
neutrophil elastase = กรดกัดผนัง alveoli ทีละน้อยทุกบุหรี่

mechanisms.label_th: NAC Mucolytic และ Glutathione Mechanism ใน Respiratory
mechanisms.label_en: NAC as Mucolytic (Disulfide Bond Cleavage) and Glutathione Precursor in Airway Defense
mechanisms.description_th: Mucus ใน airway มี glycoprotein (mucin) connected ด้วย disulfide bonds → high viscosity; NAC มี free thiol (-SH) → cleave disulfide bonds ใน mucin → ลด mucus viscosity → ง่ายต่อ mucociliary clearance; ในเวลาเดียวกัน NAC เป็น precursor ของ L-cysteine → synthesis ของ glutathione (GSH) → antioxidant ป้องกัน oxidative damage ใน airway epithelium จาก cigarette smoke / PM2.5 / viral infection
mechanisms.description_en: Airway mucus: glycoprotein (mucin) cross-linked by disulfide bonds → high viscosity; NAC free thiol (-SH) cleaves disulfide bonds in mucin → reduces viscosity → easier mucociliary clearance; simultaneously: NAC provides L-cysteine → glutathione synthesis → antioxidant protection of airway epithelium from cigarette smoke/PM2.5/viral oxidative damage.

chain.effect: mucin cross-links broken → mucus viscosity reduced → easier ciliary clearance
mucus and trapped pathogens/particles cleared from lung toward pharynx

chain.actor: NAC absorbed systemically → deacetylated to L-cysteine
chain.effect: intracellular GSH increased in airway epithelial cells

chain.target: cigarette smoke oxidants, PM2.5, viral replication byproducts
chain.effect: oxidative stress protection → less airway damage, less inflammation

analogies_th: NAC = กรรไกรตัด disulfide bond ใน mucus + สร้างเกราะ antioxidant ให้ปอด
mucus หนา = เชือกพันกัน; NAC ตัดเชือก → เสมหะหลุดออกง่าย

sources.title: Mucolytic agents versus placebo for COPD — Poole P et al. Cochrane

mechanisms.label_th: Buteyko Technique — CO₂ Tolerance Training กับ Asthma
mechanisms.label_en: Buteyko Breathing: Carbon Dioxide Tolerance Training for Airway Hyper-responsiveness
mechanisms.description_th: Buteyko theory: asthmatic patients มี chronic hyperventilation pattern → CO₂ ต่ำ → Verigo-Bohr effect (less O₂ delivery) + bronchoconstriction reflex (hypocapnia → bronchial smooth muscle spasm); Buteyko ฝึก nasal breathing + reduced breathing volume + breath holds → เพิ่ม CO₂ tolerance → reset central chemoreceptor threshold → ลด hyperventilation urge → ลด bronchoconstriction สัญญาณ
mechanisms.description_en: Buteyko theory: asthmatic patients chronically hyperventilate → low CO₂ → Verigo-Bohr effect (less O₂ delivery) + hypocapnia-induced bronchoconstriction; Buteyko trains nasal breathing + reduced breathing volume + breath holds → raises CO₂ tolerance → resets central chemoreceptor threshold → reduces hyperventilation → reduces bronchoconstriction signaling.

chain.effect: left-shifted O₂ curve (Bohr) + reflex bronchoconstriction from hypocapnia
chemoreceptor threshold recalibrated to tolerate higher CO₂
bronchodilation via NO + reduced hyperventilation trigger
less reflex bronchoconstriction → reduced need for bronchodilator rescue

analogies_th: Buteyko = reset ปุ่ม panic ของปอด — ฝึก CO₂ tolerance ใหม่ให้ไม่ alarm ง่าย
control pause = วัด CO₂ tolerance ของคุณ: BOLT < 20 = หายใจเกินปกติ; > 40 = ดี

sources.title: Breathing exercises for asthma — Cowie RL et al. Cochrane

mechanisms.label_th: PM2.5 → Systemic Inflammation: ปอดเป็น Entry Point สู่ Cardiovascular Disease
mechanisms.label_en: PM2.5 Inhalation: Alveolar Macrophage Activation to Systemic Cardiovascular Inflammation
mechanisms.description_th: PM2.5 (<2.5 μm) ผ่าน mucociliary clearance ไปถึง alveoli → alveolar macrophages phagocytose PM2.5 → oxidative stress + NF-κB activation → IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β release ใน lung → cytokines เข้า systemic circulation → endothelial inflammation → atherosclerosis progression + cardiac arrhythmia trigger; ultrafine PM (<0.1 μm) อาจข้าม BBB ได้โดยตรง
mechanisms.description_en: PM2.5 (<2.5 μm) bypasses mucociliary clearance → reaches alveoli → alveolar macrophage phagocytosis → ROS + NF-κB → IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β release → systemic circulation → endothelial inflammation → atherosclerosis + arrhythmia; ultrafine PM (<0.1 μm) may cross BBB directly.

chain.actor: PM2.5 particles inhaled nasally (partially filtered) or via mouth
chain.effect: particles too small for mucociliary clearance → trapped in lung

chain.target: ROS (from particle surface metals/organics) + NF-κB activation
chain.effect: pro-inflammatory cytokines secreted locally
systemic inflammation: endothelial activation, platelet aggregation, CRP rise
CVD events: MI, stroke (explains epidemiological PM2.5-CVD mortality link)

chain.target: cardiac arrhythmias via autonomic imbalance + direct cardiac toxicity
chain.effect: increased sudden cardiac death in high PM2.5 areas

analogies_th: PM2.5 = ทหารขนาดเล็กที่ผ่านป้อมกรอง (จมูก/ขน) ไปยึดฐาน alveoli แล้วส่ง signal อักเสบไปทั้งร่างกาย
ปอดเป็น entry gate ของ systemic inflammation — ไม่ใช่แค่ทางเดินหายใจ
